subject: Unexpected latency and elevated error rate on embeddings route — urgent
messages:
From: Eli Tan <eli.tan@brightline.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightline.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact: embeddings API spike — errors + p95 latency up

Jonas / Marissa,

We're seeing a sustained increase in end-to-end latency and a rising 5xx/error rate for our embeddings pipeline starting ~14:45 PDT. p95 for /v1/embeddings has jumped from ~120ms to 1.8s and error rate is ~4.7% for the last 30m. This is impacting real-time search and recommendations for a subset of our customers.

We pushed a light traffic test and noticed bursts correlate with larger batch windows and a high number of distinct prefixes in the requests (many short, similar keys). Our SRE dug into network and infra and doesn't see host-level saturation. We suspect something at the inference layer — possibly a cache/batching interaction causing head-of-line blocking or aggressive KV prefetch eviction.

Attached is a brief CSV with request breakdowns and a small packet of logs (logs-summary.csv). Can we get an urgent triage and a mitigation plan? We are happy to keep traffic lower for now but need a concrete timeline and plan.

Eli
Eli Tan
Head of Platform
Brightline AI

Eli — thanks for the data and the heads up.

We're treating this as an incident and spinning up an on-call runbook now. Immediate plan:
- Triage team (runtime + routing + kv) on call; pulling telemetry from the route you referenced.
- Short-term mitigation options we can apply immediately (with your OK): temporarily lower max_batch_size for the embeddings route, and disable prefix prefetch/KV prefetch for that route for 30-60 minutes to see if prefetched keys are causing eviction storms.
- If that doesn't improve errors, we can route this tenant to a lower-concurrency lane (shorter batch windows) as a fallback.

Can you confirm if you want us to proceed with the prefetch toggle? If yes we'll apply and monitor for 10 minutes. We'll also schedule a 30-min triage call in 15.

Jonas

Subject: Update: mitigation applied and next steps

Eli — quick update and next steps following our triage: 

1) What we did (timeline):
- 2029-04-09 16:02 PDT: temporarily disabled prefix prefetch for route-77 and reduced max_batch_size for the embeddings lane.
- 2029-04-09 16:10 PDT: observed immediate improvement (errors down to ~1.1%, p95 ~240ms).

2) Why we think this happened (initial RCA):
- Large number of distinct short prefixes from your workload was triggering aggressive KV prefetch. Prefetch churn caused frequent evictions on the hot shard and introduced head-of-line blocking in the hot lane during batching boundaries, which amplified latency and produced 5xx errors for some in-flight requests.

3) Next steps (short + medium):
- Short: We recommend a permanent change for your account: route isolation for prefix-heavy traffic + adjusted KV eviction thresholds. We'll prepare a configuration proposal and a rollout plan during our postmortem session.
- Medium: Engineering will open a cross-team RFC to add automatic hotkey isolation and safer defaults for prefix prefetch under high-cardinality signals.

4) Customer care: As Ben authorized, we will issue a one-off 10% usage credit for the impacted billing period; Legal will finalize language.

We're scheduling a 60-min postmortem next week — proposed times in the calendar link. Please let us know which slot works. Thank you for the quick reports and patience while we stabilized this.

Best,
Jonas
